question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Let’s distribute the __surplus__ food to the needy.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dearth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"surplus"** means something that is more than what is needed or used; excess. (अधिशेष)

 
 
• **Example:** The farmer had a surplus of crops this year, which he sold in the market.
 
 
 
• The word **"Dearth"** means end or absence of something, which is the opposite of having an excess. (कमी)
 
 
• **Example:** The dearth of resources in that area caused great hardship for the people.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"surplus"** is **"dearth".**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dearth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stale** (बासी): Something that is no longer fresh or pleasant.

 
 
• **Example:** The bread was stale, so we couldn’t eat it.
 
 
 
• **Hot** (गरम): Having a high temperature; warm.
 
 
• **Example:** The tea was so hot that I had to wait for it to cool down.
 
 
 
• **Huge** (विशाल): Extremely large in size, quantity, or degree.
 
 
• **Example:** The huge building towered over the small houses nearby.
